verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers AI features inside the product: instant AI summaries of mail and automatic labels or categorization (docs-4, docs-9). That covers AI-generated insights at the level of individual mail items. Nothing shows actionable suggestions or insights across the user's mail as a whole, and the only support is brief marketing copy. Missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, insights across the user's whole mailbox, detailed docs on the AI features, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
